passage.text: At lunchtime, Nam, Ploy and Top were sitting in the student cafeteria.
passage.reading: ət ˈlʌntʃtaɪm, ˈnɑːm, ˈplɔɪ ənd ˈtɑːp wɜːr ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈstuːdənt ˌkæfəˈtɪriə.

passage.text: The university was doing a survey: should students still have to wear uniforms?
passage.reading: ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti wʌz ˈduːɪŋ ə ˈsɜːrveɪ: ʃʊd ˈstuːdənts ˈstɪl ˈhæf tə ˈwɛr ˈjuːnəfɔːrmz?

passage.text: "Uniforms are outdated," Top said. "Most universities in the world don't have them."
passage.reading: ˈjuːnəfɔːrmz ər ˌaʊtˈdeɪtɪd, ˈtɑːp ˈsɛd. ˈmoʊst ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ðɛm.

passage.text: "I see your point," Ploy said, "but I like my uniform."
passage.reading: aɪ ˈsiː jʊr ˈpɔɪnt, ˈplɔɪ ˈsɛd, bʌt aɪ ˈlaɪk maɪ ˈjuːnəfɔːrm.

passage.text: "It looks neat, and I don't have to think about what to wear every morning."
passage.reading: ɪt ˈlʊks ˈniːt, ənd aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈθɪŋk əˈbaʊt ˈwʌt tə ˈwɛr ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: "Also, when everyone wears the same clothes, no one can tell who is rich or poor."
passage.reading: ˈɔːlsoʊ, wɛn ˈɛvriwʌn ˈwɛrz ðə ˈseɪm ˈkloʊðz, ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn kən ˈtɛl huː ɪz ˈrɪtʃ ɔːr ˈpʊr.

passage.text: "Rules like that are pointless," he said. "We're adults, not high school students."
passage.reading: ˈruːlz ˈlaɪk ðæt ər ˈpɔɪntləs, hiː ˈsɛd. wɪr əˈdʌlts, ˈnɑːt ˈhaɪ ˌskuːl ˈstuːdənts.

passage.text: "Everyone is an individual, and we should be able to show our own style."
passage.reading: ˈɛvriwʌn ɪz ən ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəl, ənd wiː ʃʊd bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈʃoʊ aʊr ˈoʊn ˈstaɪl.

passage.text: "Personally, I think we should wear uniforms for exams and important days," she said.
passage.reading: ˈpɜːrsənəli, aɪ ˈθɪŋk wiː ʃʊd ˈwɛr ˈjuːnəfɔːrmz fər ɪɡˈzæmz ənd ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈdeɪz, ʃiː ˈsɛd.

passage.text: "On other days, students could choose what to wear."
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈʌðər ˈdeɪz, ˈstuːdənts kʊd ˈtʃuːz ˈwʌt tə ˈwɛr.

passage.text: Ploy and Top looked at each other.
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ ənd ˈtɑːp ˈlʊkt ət ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər.

passage.text: "That's actually a good idea," Top said.
passage.reading: ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ə ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə, ˈtɑːp ˈsɛd.
aɪ ˈkʊdənt əˈɡriː ˈmɔːr, ˈsɛd ˈplɔɪ.

passage.text: Then all three of them filled out the survey together.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ˈɔːl ˈθriː əv ðɛm ˈfɪld ˈaʊt ðə ˈsɜːrveɪ təˈɡɛðər.
